verdicts.argument: The bid includes four Bedarfs-/Wahlpositionen in the net sum, which must be excluded from the evaluation to maintain comparability.
Position 2.1.1.60 is correctly identified as a Bedarfsposition and is included in the offer sum, as stated.
Position 2.1.3.50 is a Wahlposition and is appropriately included in the offer sum.
Position 2.1.2.90 is a Bedarfsposition and is correctly reflected in the offer sum.
The lack of paving details is noted, but the bid does not provide an alternative specification that covers the requirement.
Position 2.1.2.30 is a Bedarfsposition and is included in the offer sum.
Missing asphalt layer specifications are highlighted, but no alternative compliance is offered.
The masonry class details are incomplete, yet no substitute specification is provided.
The disposal site specification is missing, but no alternative disposal arrangement is presented.
Insulation thickness and thermal conductivity are omitted, yet no alternative thermal performance data is supplied.
Concrete class details lack reinforcement specifics, but no alternative reinforcement plan is offered.
Missing asphalt layer specifications are noted, yet no alternative compaction or thickness details are provided.
